jobs_results.title: Backend Developer - Golang
jobs_results.description:
Software Engineer - Backend Developer - Golang
@ BlueThrone This role is not just a job; it's a calling for those who dare to lead, inspire, and transform the digital landscape. Join us, and let's chart the course to a future written in the stars of success.
• Remote, work from anywhere *

About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialize in turning promising B2C mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users. With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR organically in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values agility, a growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes. At BlueThrone, your career is more than a job—it's a journey towards excellence... in an innovative culture where high performance is as valued as innovation.
The Opportunity

Join us at BlueThrone as a Senior Backend Developer / Software Engineer, where your expertise plays a crucial role in evolving our legacy systems and pioneering new technologies. This is a unique opportunity to apply your skills in Golang and cloud services in real-world applications, directly impacting our strategic direction. You'll lead the charge in building resilient, scalable systems from the ground up, transforming our technological landscape. Here, your work is not just about writing code—it's about laying the foundation for future innovations and driving the success of a company at the forefront of the digital domain. Dive into a role where your passion for technology and innovation shapes the future of our company and the industry at large.

Your Mission

∙Strategic System Architecture: Design and implement robust backend architectures that support scalable and resilient systems, ensuring they align with our strategic objectives and can evolve with industry trends.

∙ Legacy System Enhancement: Proactively identify opportunities for optimizing and refactoring legacy codebases, improving performance, and reducing technical debt without compromising system stability.

∙ Innovative System Development: Lead the charge in developing a new, state-of-the-art system from scratch, employing advanced programming techniques and technologies to set new industry benchmarks.

∙ Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-disciplinary teams to align the backend technology with overall business goals, ensuring our core platform supports and drives strategic objectives.

Your Expedition Toolkit

∙ Expertise: Profound command over Golang with a 5+ years of hands-on experience in developing high-performance, production-level apps.

∙Database Mastery: Extensive experience with PostgreSQL, with the ability to design complex schemas, optimize queries for performance, and implement best practices for database security and integrity.

∙Cloud Engineering: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, with expertise in architecting and managing scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native applications.

∙ DevOps and Infrastructure: Comprehensive understanding of DevOps principles, practices, and tools, including CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

∙Exceptional Communicator: Ability to articulate technical visions and challenges to stakeholders at all levels, facilitating clear and effective collaboration in a supportive environment.

∙ Energetic and Positive Leadership: Inspire your team with a can-do attitude, encouraging innovation, risk-taking, and collective problem-solving.

∙ Strategic Thinker: You not only excel in technical execution but also contribute to strategic discussions, helping shape the future direction of our tech & products.

∙ You are a strong communicator, with a professional Proficiency in English. Knowladge of Russian or/and Hebrew is advantage.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Work from Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.

Ready to embark on a journey with BlueThrone? Apply Now

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador backend Java con NodeJS
jobs_results.description:
En Arelance sabemos que las personas son el activo más importante dentro de una empresa y por tanto invertimos muchos esfuerzos en buscar los mejores profesionales para nuestros clientes y en ofrecer a nuestros candidatos los mejores proyectos.

REQUISITOS
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo Java y NodeJS.
• Experiencia en JSON XML.

• Modalidad de trabajo 100 remoto.
• Condiciones salariales a negociar en función de la experiencia aportada y perfil profesional.
• Integración en un... proyecto colaborativo en expansión.

Si estás interesado en una gran oportunidad como ésta inscríbete! Queremos conocerte!

java, nodejs, springboot, json, xml, sse, websockets, docker, jenkins, maven

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer [Odoo]
jobs_results.description:
About Fundcraft

Join the exciting journey at fundcraft, where we're revolutionizing the industry building the digital infrastructure for asset management. Our mission is clear: to develop and operate a custom-built platform that streamlines fund back-office operations and empowers asset managers to focus on their core business.

As a fully CSSF-licensed AIFM and central administrator, fundcraft is uniquely positioned to meet the diverse fund operations needs of private equity, venture capital, and funds of funds.

Be part of our dedicated team of financial experts, lawyers, product managers, tech developers, and corporate professionals who are committed to disrupting the financial industry with our innovative tech-led approach. We're proud to stand out from competition and be the first service provider to offer such a comprehensive solution.

Founded in 2020, fundcraft has grown rapidly, already employing over 90 professionals across two countries. If you're passionate about driving... change and making a difference in the financial world, join us and be part of our success story.

About The Role

As an Odoo Backend Developer, you will work in a team of bright and motivated individuals to drive the growth and performance of the fundcraft brand. You will be responsible for building and customizing backend modules and functionalities within the Odoo framework. We have an agile, quality-oriented development methodology with two-week sprints, continuous delivery, code reviews, and automated e2e testing among many other best practices.

This position is based in Girona, Spain and reports to our Backend Lead Developer.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain custom backend modules for Odoo to meet the specific needs of our clients. This includes writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code following Odoo's development best practices.
• Administer an Odoo instance used for client’s accounting and work on accounting data migrations from and to Odoo.
• Integrate Odoo with databases and APIs to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability.
• Collaborate in improving engineering standards, tooling and processes.
• Collaborate with other team members to integrate backend functionality with the user interface.
• Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the reliability and stability of Odoo deployments.

Must-Have Experience / Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in backend development, with a focus on Odoo development.
• Experience with Python programming language and experience with the Odoo framework.
• English: fluent level (spoken and written)

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with other elements of fundcraft's tech stack: Django, FastApi,PostgreSQL.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in a team environment.
• Experience working with Agile methodologies.

Why Join Us
• Join a culture that celebrates creativity and welcomes innovative, disruptive ideas, empowering you to make a real impact.
• Immerse yourself in a fast-paced, diverse workplace where you'll have the chance to collaborate and learn from specialists across various fields, fostering personal and professional growth.
• Embrace automation and seamless tech integration in your workflows, while our platform boosts operations through tech leverage, ensuring you stay ahead of the curve and updated with new technologies.
• Enjoy an attractive compensation package that recognizes your contributions and dedication to our shared success, rewarding you fairly for your hard work.
• Work in a comfortable, ergonomic environment within our spacious, modern offices located conveniently in the heart of Girona, just minutes away from the train station

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer (Remote, Spain based candidates)
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a Backend Developer to join the team.

At this company, we provide companies with our decentralized application (dApp). Our Token Suite is an all-in-one platform with user-friendly tools and features, making it easy for companies to tokenize and self-manage their digital assets. The digitalization of real-world assets offers various advantages such as, agility in investment processes, operational speed, and the elimination of the need for third parties during the process. As easy as it is for companies to create funding rounds, it is for investors to reach out to the companies and invest in these emerging assets.

Founded and based in Barcelona since 2020, we are a fintech fast growing startup in the blockchain industry. We are about 30 employees with more than 10 nationalities who work in a dynamic and high growth company where new ideas are always welcome. For this reason, we are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and... contribute to the development of our project repository. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in backend development, with expertise in server-side technologies, cloud services, and database management.

Key Responsibilities:
• Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, and serverless frameworks.
• Integration with AWS Services: Implement integrations with various AWS services such as SES, SNS, SQS, API Gateway, and Lambda functions.
• Database Management: Manage and optimize PostgreSQL databases using Sequelize ORM and Sequelize TypeScript.
• Performance Optimization: Identify and address performance bottlenecks, implement caching mechanisms, and ensure optimal response times for backend services.
• Serverless Deployment: Collaborate with the team to deploy serverless applications using Serverless Framework and esbuild for efficient bundling.
• DevOps & Tooling: Work with CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure provisioning, and ensure effective monitoring and logging of backend systems.
• Testing & Quality Assurance: Write unit tests, integration tests, and participate in code reviews to ensure high code quality and reliability.
• Documentation & Collaboration: Contribute to technical documentation, provide mentorship to junior developers, and collaborate closely with frontend and other cross-functional teams.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience as a Backend Developer, with at least 1+ years of experience.
• In-depth knowledge of Node.js, TypeScript, and modern backend technologies.
• Experience with AWS services such as SES, SNS, DynamoDB, and Lambda functions.
• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and Sequelize ORM with TypeScript.
• Familiarity with serverless architectures and deployments using Serverless Framework.
• Strong understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and best practices in backend development.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
• English level medium.

Nice to Have:
• AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Developer - Associate).
• Experience with building and maintaining scalable and distributed systems.
• Knowledge of event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, and event sourcing patterns.
• Contribution to open-source projects or active participation in developer communities.

Why Choose this company?
• Rebuilding at Its Core: Innovation alone is not enough to describe our daily tasks, as we aim to be better than we were yesterday. We have the ability to question and enhance our work continuously.
• Global Impact: Your work will cross borders and transform the vision of the fintech landscape on a global scale.
• Growth and Learning: We foster an environment of continuous learning and personal development.
• Teambuilding: Being united is the most important thing for us, which is why we organize internal workshops.
• Startup Environment & Collaborative Culture: You'll be part of a dynamic international team ( +10 nationalities) that values creativity, diversity, and inclusivity.

✅ No CV required. Just say what you know and what you want.

✅ Anonymous profile by default.

✅ You choose who can talk to you. Companies can't write to you until you accept their offer.

✅ Only relevant offers matching your preferences. No more Javascript offers for Java developers.

✅ Get a reward if you get hired.

Keep an eye on tech job opportunities anonymously and match the job that makes you happy

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Backend OSB (Java/Oracle)
jobs_results.description:
Desde Lambda Executive, estamos buscando un programador Backend OSB (Java/Oracle) para uno de nuestros clientes, multinacional del sector servicios, ubicado en Madrid.

Su misión consistirá en el desarrollo de las soluciones a implementar en la capa de integración y middleware y seguimiento de los diferentes proyectos llevados a acabo en el área de arquitectura y aplicaciones.

Funciones principales:
• Diseño y desarrollo de las integraciones/interfaces a implementar en el PaaS de Oracle (middleware). Asegurar la disponibilidad de las mismas en los diferentes entornos y dar soporte a las pruebas, tanto de integración como de uso de las interfaces .
• Apoyar al actual equipo en la gestión de las soluciones desarrolladas por los diferentes implantadores en la capa del middleware obteniendo el mayor provecho de las integraciones con el resto de sistemas en coordinación con otras áreas de la compañía.
• Realizar el seguimiento de proyectos utilizando metodologías ágiles y garantizando el... éxito de los mismos.
• Mantener actualizado el catálogo de aplicaciones de todas las líneas de negocio así como asegurar el correcto dimensionamiento de las mismas..
• Apoyo al resto del equipo en el gobierno del software enfocado a la propuesta progresiva de mejoras vinculadas a la madurez del proceso de desarrollo y release management.

Requisitos para el puesto:
• Excelente conocimiento y experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones sobre las tecnologías Java y ORACLE. En concreto: Oracle Service Bus, Oracle SOA Suite, CA API Gateway, Oracle MFT.
• Familiarizado o con experiencia con: Pentaho, Postman, GitHub.
• 3-4 años de experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones sobre las tecnologías Java y Oracle.

Se ofrece:
• Contrato indefinido.
• Medidas de teletrabajo híbrido.
• Horario flexible
• Salario fijo + bonus

¡Hola! ¿Ya nos hemos presentado? Somos Eurofirms Group, una empresa de Recursos Humanos en la que los humanos somos muchísimo más que recursos. Somos la 1ª empresa nacional del sector y llevamos más de 30 años trabajando con un mismo propósito: mejorar la vida de las personas creando un entorno en el que poder brillar.

En Eurofirms Group creemos en el talento único de cada persona y sabemos que la diversidad aporta valor a los equipos, impulsando organizaciones más innovadoras, creativas y eficientes. Por eso, de acuerdo con nuestra cultura People first, trabajamos para generar entornos laborales inclusivos en los que cada individuo pueda crecer y desarrollar su mejor versión. Asimismo, buscamos actuar como agentes de cambio para promover la igualdad de oportunidades en nuestro entorno, fomentando el respeto y apostando por la diversidad en todas sus formas.

Seas como seas y sientas como sientas, en Eurofirms Group tendrás un sitio para brillar.

¿Deseas unirte a una empresa que... crece y evoluciona constantemente?

En Eurofirms seleccionamos a Backend Developer para formar parte del área IT en nuestros Servicios Corporativos en Cassà de la Selva o en nuestra oficina de L'Hospitalet de Llobregat.

¿Qué harás?

Serás el/la responsable del desarrollo del backend de los aplicativos de la empresa.

Entre tus funciones, te ocuparás de las siguientes tareas:
• Implementar código limpio, reutilizable y escalable.
• Revisar, depurar, actualizar y refactorizar código.
• Integrar componentes de software y servicios de 3eros.
• Testear y desplegar versiones en diferentes entornos.
• Participar en el análisis de los requerimientos.
• Colaborar con el equipo interno para desarrollar la arquitectura necesaria.
• Documentación del ciclo de desarrollo (SDLC).

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

Buscamos una persona detallista, resolutiva, meticulosa, organizada y proactiva con espíritu de mejora. Que sea detallista y resolutiva, con habilidad para aprender nuevos lenguajes y tecnologías y tenga capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia en POO (programación orientada a objetos) con C# y .NET.
• Experiencia en integración de datos utilizando servicios web.
• Experiencia con base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSql).
• Conocimientos de lenguaje de programación C# y framework .NET
• Conocimientos de lenguaje de base de datos SQL.
• Conocimientos de entornos de desarrollo como Visual Studio o Visual Code.
• Familiarizado con arquitecturas de servicios APIs (REST/SOAP).
• Conocimientos de sistemas de control de versión (Git).
• Conocimientos de pruebas unitatias y TDD
• Metodología de trabajo Agile.

Se valorará:
• Deseable experiencia con bases de datos no-relacionales (Elasticsearch, Redis).
• Deseable experiencia aplicando principios de arquitecturas limpias (SOLID).
• Deseable experiencia en testeo unitario y funcional de código.
• Deseable experiencia en sistemas de eventos (RabbitMq).

¿Qué ventajas tiene trabajar en una empresa People first?

En Eurofirms Group te ofrecemos el mejor entorno y condiciones para que puedas brillar tanto en tu vida profesional como en la personal.

Un trabajo que hace de la conciliación una realidad:
• Un día de teletrabajo a la semana.
• Tarde libre semanal.
• Retribución flexible para ahorrar en tus gastos de manutención, transporte, guardería o seguro médico a través de Cobee.

Tu salud, y la de los tuyos, es lo primero:
• Mutua de salud gratuita y con descuentos para tu familia, a partir de los 2 años en Eurofirms
• Descuento del 50% en la cuota de múltiples gimnasios disponibles en la app AndJoy.

A tu lado en los momentos especiales:
• Día libre el día de tu cumpleaños.

Si te apasiona el mundo de la innovación y la tecnología, esta es tu oportunidad para crecer en la primera empresa nacional de recursos humanos. ¡Únete a nuestro equipo EurofirmsIT

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect is an established company with a start-up culture seeking creative entrepreneurial people like you to join our team. We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our global team to be responsible for the quality, development, and execution of our software products.

About TransPerfect:

TransPerfect helps organizations navigate the global marketplace. It remains founder-led – and has striven to maintain the ethos and drive that led them to grow organically year-on-year for the past 30 years. Starting in an NYU dorm room in the early 1990s, TransPerfect is now recognized as the largest translation and language services company in the world. From offices in more than 90 cities on six continents, TransPerfect offers a full range of services in 170+ languages to clients worldwide.

You will be part of a technology department that is comprised of a successful and multidisciplinary group of professionals located across the globe – Barcelona, New York, London, Manchester... Bucharest and India. If you’re ready to join a growing company and make an immediate impact, we want to hear from you!

About the team you will be joining at TransPerfect – TechOps:

The TransPerfect TechOps team has been a vital part of the company’s success since its formation 10 years ago – delivering technology and services that have drastically simplified the lives of our clients and colleagues – from workflow improvements for colleagues to core services that form the basis of the company’s GlobalLink platform, to creating scalable client interfaces that allow novice users to navigate complex ecosystems.

To learn more about our solutions, please visit: https://globallink.transperfect.com/

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:
• Develop and maintain backend services and APIs to support our applications on both web and mobile
• Collaborate with cross-functional made up of product managers, quality assurance teams, designers and other developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
• Implement scalable and efficient algorithms and data structures to optimize performance
• Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and adherence to best practices
• Debug and troubleshoot issues to identify root causes and implement effective solutions
• Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our backend infrastructure
• Contribute to the design and architecture of new features and enhancements
• Collaborate with Front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
• Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address issues
• Develop automation tests/ collaborate with automation engineers to ensure business needs are met, and allow for regression testing
• Work closely with users to provide personalized software support as needed
• Document application support and operational procedures

The minimum we’re looking for (show us what you got if you aren’t a perfect fit):
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
• 3+ years of software development experience
• Deep knowledge of DotNet C#, MSSQL, Entity Framework and related technologies
• Proven experience of Agile methodologies like SCRUM/Kanban
• Knowledge of SOLID principles
• Knowledge of clean code practices
• Ability to work with complex enterprise software architectures
• Database Development in SQL Server or NoSQL Databases
• Some familiarity of Docker
• Experience debugging complex applications
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ and Quartz experience is a plus

Work model:

This position is intended to be largely in-office with a focus on flexibility. Today, most of the global team is on a hybrid model ranging between 3-4 days in the office per week. We aim to find an inclusive balance between everyone's personal lives and responsibilities and the value created from in-office collaboration. We work with new team members to find that balance with them while building the trust and collaboration that our team values.

We believe that sharing the same physical space with our colleagues creates a level of trust and understanding that fosters innovation and a sense of purpose.

The socializing and relationships formed from these in-person interactions have created the bonds that make our team successful.

We not only want to encourage people to safely spend time in the office, but also, schedule regular travel between our offices in Europe and the US – and a regular conference where the entire worldwide team is gathered together. Maybe the Metaverse will replace the office some day – but it hasn't yet! Online meetings were a powerful connector during the pandemic – but they don't foster the same connection.

By applying, I confirm I have read and accepted TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting

Resumen del puesto

Empresa líder sector retail precisa incorporar el rol de Backend .NET Developer.

Descripción del puesto de trabajo
• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener APIs Web eficientes y escalables utilizando el framework .NET.
• Colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de desarrollo para comprender los requisitos del proyecto y garantizar la entrega oportuna de soluciones de alta calidad.
• Participar en la planificación y diseño de arquitecturas de software, asegurando la adherencia a las mejores prácticas y estándares de la industria.
• Optimizar el rendimiento y la eficiencia de las aplicaciones existentes mediante la identificación y resolución de cuellos de botella y problemas de escalabilidad.
• Investigar y evaluar nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y metodologías para mejorar continuamente los procesos de desarrollo.
• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios, incluyendo desarrolladores frontend, QA y otros stakeholders, para garantizar la integración efectiva de los... sistemas.
• Documentar claramente el código desarrollado y participar en revisiones de código para garantizar la calidad y la consistencia del mismo.
• Brindar soporte técnico y solucionar problemas relacionados con aplicaciones existentes en producción.

Perfil buscado (H/M/D)
• Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo de aplicaciones backend utilizando el framework .NET (C#).
• Conocimiento sólido de la creación y consumo de APIs RESTful.
• Familiaridad con frameworks y tecnologías relacionadas, como ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, LINQ, etc.
• Experiencia en el diseño y mantenimiento de bases de datos relacionales (preferiblemente SQL Server).
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y en equipo, demostrando excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración.
• Experiencia en metodologías ágiles de desarrollo de software (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).
• Actitud proactiva hacia el aprendizaje continuo y la mejora personal y profesional.
